senses.gloss:
मु m. (-मुः)
 1. Binding, confinement.
 2. Tawny, (the colour.)
 3. ŚIVA.
4. Eternal beatitude or final emancipation.
 5. A funeral pile. E.
मू to bind, aff. क्विप्; or मुच् to loosen, &c., aff. डु ।
मू r. 1st cl. (मवते) To bind, to tie, to make fast.

मू f. (-मूः) Binding, tying.
 E. मू to tie, aff. क्विप् ।
